title: Security and Platform — Host/Container/JVM/ZK/Swarm
description: Single-pane infra/JVM/host per 2026-08-22 re-scope: host CPU/mem/disk/net, container CPU/mem/restarts, JVM heap/GC/threads, ZK ensemble, Swarm, credential/TLS/audit. Sources: node_exporter:9100, cadvisor:8080, OTel Javaagent jvm.*, filelog/infrastructure, O2 traces. Bounded labels only.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) as x, avg(value) as y FROM metrics WHERE metric_name='node_cpu_seconds_total' GROUP BY x ORDER BY x

panels.title: Host memory — node_memory_MemAvailable per vm_id
panels.description: ALERT-DISK-20 free <20% and JVM heap >85% share host panels.

queries.query: SELECT avg(value) as y, _timestamp as x FROM metrics WHERE metric_name='node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes' GROUP BY x ORDER BY x
SELECT avg(value) as y, _timestamp as x FROM metrics WHERE metric_name='node_filesystem_avail_bytes' GROUP BY x ORDER BY x

panels.title: Container CPU/memory/restarts — container_* per container
panels.description: container_cpu_usage_seconds_total container_memory_usage_bytes per container label. Restarts via cadvisor.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) as x, avg(value) as y FROM metrics WHERE metric_name='container_memory_usage_bytes' GROUP BY x ORDER BY x

panels.title: JVM heap — jvm_memory_used / max per service_name
panels.description: ALERT-JVM-HEAP-85 85% Critical → safe-halt. OTel Javaagent jvm.* per service ingestion/gateway/bridge/nautilus.

queries.query: SELECT avg(value) as y, _timestamp as x FROM metrics WHERE metric_name='jvm_memory_used_bytes' GROUP BY x ORDER BY x
SELECT histogram(_timestamp) as x, count(*) as y FROM metrics WHERE metric_name='jvm_gc_duration_seconds' GROUP BY x ORDER BY x

panels.title: ZK — zk_up followers quorum latency
panels.description: zk_up per member zookeeper-1..3. Quorum 2/3. Latency zk_followers.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) as x, count(*) as y FROM metrics WHERE metric_name='zk_up' GROUP BY x ORDER BY x

panels.title: Credential age / TLS / audit — infrastructure_logs tail
panels.description: Tail of infrastructure_logs stream for credential expiry, TLS, audit access, support-bundle. Bounded LIMIT 100.

queries.query: SELECT _timestamp, body FROM logs WHERE stream='infrastructure_logs' ORDER BY _timestamp DESC LIMIT 100
